the CMS production and user analysis systems have reached the stability and performance needed for LHC operation.
the CMS production and user analysis systems are stable and scalable and are able to meet the needs of the experiment.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have a stable and scalable system in place, which can handle the needs of the experiment.
the CMS gLite-WMS is stable and scalable enough to handle the current and future LHC data challenges.

The main takeaway from our work is that

the gLite-WMs is a mature system that is well suited for production and analysis of large experiments like CMS and that the improvements made to the gLite-WM/LB and CMS tools allow for stable operations at a high throughput.
the gLite-WM/LB system has been proved to be a stable, reliable and scalable production and analysis infrastructure for the CMS experiment.
the gLite-WM is still a very good choice for the WMS in CMS, and that we can rely on it for the next LHC data taking.
